materials.cover_letter:
I build AI workflows and the evaluation systems to know if they actually work. That is the job, and I have been doing it for seven years. CivicPlus works with sensitive and regulated data, so automation has to be right before it ships. That constraint is central to how I work.

At Redwood, I built FlareGuard, an AI content validation suite with automated benchmarks and quality scoring that cut escalations by 70-80%. I automated a documentation pipeline with Playwright screenshots that removed a manual step our engineers hated, and I built a PDF generation pipeline that ended a customer complaint that had been open for years. Each one required Python, API integration, and careful handling of internal data, the same stack your team runs on.

Your posting says you need someone who can build AI-enabled workflows, integrate systems, and document standards so the work holds up. I have done exactly that, at three companies, and I am looking for the next hard version of it. I would welcome the conversation.
